description: This file defines the Manufacturer controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying a list of manufacturers, their associated products, and detailed information about specific manufacturers, including filtering, sorting, and pagination functionality.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing manufacturer listing and detail pages, including filtering, sorting, and pagination of manufacturers and their products.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of manufacturers, categories, and initial setup for manufacturer listing page.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles displaying detailed information about a specific manufacturer, including their products, filtering options, sorting, and pagination.
